    "root_cause_hypothesis": "In md_process_line, when an admonition is detected, *p_pivot_line is not reset to &md_dummy_blank_line. This leaves pivot_line pointing to a stale line_buf entry. In the next md_process_doc iteration, line may switch to the same buffer as pivot_line, causing md_analyze_line to overwrite the pivot data. This leads to incorrect line->type values and eventually a global-buffer-overflow when reading line->type in md_start_new_block.",
    "fix_commit": "5f9b246 (adds *p_pivot_line = &md_dummy_blank_line in admonition branch)",

    "regression_test_inputs": [

      "> [!noteX]\\n> foo\\n"
    ],
    "harness_path": "/tmp/harness (built with gcc -fsanitize=address)",
    "poc_file": "/workspace/poc1.bin (contains 8-byte header + '    codeblock\\n> [!note]\\n> foo\\n')"
  },
  "CODE_STATE": {

      "md_analyze_line": "line 6003, fills line struct",
      "md_ascii_case_eq": "line 362, case-insensitive string comparison"
    },
    "data_structures": {
      "MD_LINE_ANALYSIS": "struct with type, data, enforce_new_block, beg, end, indent",
      "md_dummy_blank_line": "global const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS = {MD_LINE_BLANK, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}",
      "MD_ADMONITION_TAGS": "global array of strings: note, tip, important, warning, caution"
    },
    "fuzzer_format": "First 8 bytes = parser_flags (uint32) + renderer_flags (uint32), then markdown input"
  },
  "TESTS": {
    "crash_signature": "Global-buffer-overflow READ 4 in md_start_new_block -> md_parse -> md_html",
    "current_status": "PoC created but not yet tested with harness",
    "test_inputs": [
      "    codeblock\\n> [!note]\\n> foo\\n (from regression test)",
      "> [!noteX]\\n> foo\\n (from regression test)"
    ]
  },

      "/workspace/poc1.bin - first PoC candidate"
    ]
  },

    "submission": "submit.sh requires poc file and candidate_trace.json"
  },
